select bp_tag_instance.id, bp_tag_instance.tag_name, bp_tag_type.tag_type_name, bp_tag_scene.tag_scene_name, bp_tag_instance.is_enable as enable from bp_tag_instance left join bp_tag_type on bp_tag_instance.tag_type_id = bp_tag_type.id and bp_tag_type.is_deleted = 0 left join bp_tag_scene on bp_tag_instance.tag_scene_id = bp_tag_scene.id and bp_tag_scene.is_deleted = 0
bp_tag_instance.is_deleted = 0
and bp_tag_instance.tag_type_id = #{pageQuery.tagTypeId}
and bp_tag_instance.tag_name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.tagName}, '%')
and bp_tag_scene.tag_scene_name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.tagSceneName}, '%')
order by bp_tag_instance.create_time
